notes.title: Patch v0.90.2 (Early Access Update 5)
notes.content:
This fifth update since Early Access doesn’t bring new content, but it continues to refine Nocturne FX™ under the hood—with new settings, engine fixes, and better tooling for both players and development. Most of these changes enhance flexibility, improve sound and visual consistency, or support future expansion.



🧠 Engine & Logic Fixes

Camera wrapping fixed: Visual issues beyond 100,000 units (clouds failing, stars shifting) have been resolved.

Wrap boundary increased: From 100,000 → 1,000,000 units to delay coordinate overflows far beyond normal runs.

Settings system upgraded: Now supports more than booleans, which opens the door for future numeric or typed configuration fields without boilerplate.



🔊 Master Volume Control

Added a new Master Volume setting (0–100), allowing overall audio scaling while keeping the balance between sounds (e.g. pew is louder than flap).

Enables dynamic tuning without distorting mix levels.

This is the first feature built using the new settings system.



🧾 Debug Console Enhancement

Output now duplicates to both the in-game console and system stdout/stderr.

Ensures error messages or crash info is preserved—even when the debug UI is open.



📊 Run Summary Tweak

Score is now included in the optional end-of-run summary.

Previously showed only time, flaps, and power-ups—this change reflects direct player feedback.

notes.title: Patch v0.90.1 (Early Access Update 4)
notes.content:
This fourth update since Early Access doesn't bring new content, but it does significantly enhance the game’s underlying performance. Whether you're on a high-refresh display or an older laptop, you should notice smoother, more consistent gameplay across the board.



⚙️ Major Performance Improvements

A new software-based VSync emulation system has been implemented, offering precise frame pacing, timing drift correction, and hybrid sleep/spin logic, resulting in:

Frame delivery is now smoother and more consistent

CPU usage is cut nearly in half on average

1% Low FPS has improved dramatically, especially at high refresh rates

This system is enabled by default. While you can disable it in the settings, it’s not recommended.



🖥️ VRR Support

A new “VRR Support” option allows per-frame refresh rate detection, improving compatibility with GSync, FreeSync, and other variable refresh displays.

This is disabled by default but can be toggled in the settings menu.



🔒 Frame Profiling

The old "Show FPS" option has been replaced with "Show Performance Metrics", now displaying both average FPS and a rolling 30-second 1% Low FPS.

Press［TAB］in the debug menu to export a detailed benchmark JSON to the new frame_profiles folder, which includes:

Timestamped frame timing data from the past 5 minutes

Heap usage

Detected spikes

Additional metrics

Note:

Frame data is reset every run

Only active gameplay records frames (not during pause, game over, or menus)

For uninterrupted benchmarking, it is recommended to use［G］godmode.



🌠 Other Fixes and Improvements

Stars now fade out properly when night turns to day instead of disappearing instantaneously.

Rare rain restart issue fixed (added cooldown between weather events).

The debug menu log activation message now correctly persists.

The settings menu has been updated with better descriptions and tooltips.

Launch4j packaging corrected to eliminate redundant packaging, reducing file size.

notes.title: Patch v0.9 (Early Access Update 3)
notes.content:
This third update since Early Access launch brings sweeping improvements to game systems, visuals, and performance—alongside new security architecture to protect the integrity of the experience.



🖼️ Main Menu Customization

All menu buttons have been redesigned, replacing the default, generic JavaFX buttons.

Market menu and back buttons have been resized for cleaner layout.



🌧️ Dynamic Rain Overhaul

Rain has been transformed from a binary effect into a state-based system, allowing smooth transitions between weather phases.

The rain palette effect has been expanded.

Procedural raindrop spawning has been refined for better realism.



🎲 Smarter Randomness

All randomness systems have been rebuilt using a modern, centralized randomization factory based on Xoshiro256PlusPlus.

Enhances gameplay consistency, balancing, and lays groundwork for seeding and replay support in future updates.



🔴 Red Pipe Behavior Mutation

Red pipes may now rarely oscillate once a certain point threshold has been reached.



🎵 Music System Enhancements

A new chaos track has been added.

All music now uses .wav format to eliminate stuttering or load delays.

Music and sound effects can now be toggled independently in the settings menu.



✨ Miscellaneous Changes and Bug Fixes

Fixed flickering popup text at the top left of the screen.

Resolved an error related to rainbow music not stopping when a new high score is achieved.

Fixed a settings synchronization issue.

Implemented new fallback systems for data recovery.

Overhauled file security.

Various minor improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Patch v0.89.9 (Early Access Update 2)
notes.content:
This second update since Early Access launch brings new features and a number of fixes, tweaks, and key improvements.



🔫 New Power Up: Gun

Purchase use tickets in the market for 10 gold each and activate with the［P］key — or wait for it to spawn naturally.

Auto-fire alien phaser beams every 1.5 seconds for a total of eight phaser beams to obliterate pipes and damage special encounters.



🏆 New Achievement: Gunslinger

Survive the attack on Ultranightmare using a gun to earn this challenge reward and gain 20 XP and 10 gold.



🎮 Massive Input Overhaul

Input handling has been completely refactored. Expect cleaner controls, better state accuracy, and no more accidental flaps after unpausing or restarting.

The debug keys for chaos and time adjustment can now be held for easier tuning and better experimentation.



🔊 Sound Polish

Background music volume lowered from 0.33 → 0.25.

XP sound volume increased from 1 → 1.25.

New "pew" sound introduced with gun.



🧾 Misc Improvements

Version display now matches patch format.

Unified exit logic and UI alignment polish.

notes.title: Patch v0.89.8 (Early Access Update 1)
notes.content:
This first update since Early Access launch brings a handful of key improvements based on feedback and internal polish.



🎮 Input Handling Fixes

Held key inputs are now fully blocked — no more double-flaps or sticky restarts. Controls should feel tighter and more reliable across the board.

Unpause-To-Flap cooldown removed.

Key combinations now possible for future updates.



💥 Shockwave Rebalance

Shockwave scoring now scales with difficulty:

 5 pts – Baby & Regular (unchanged)

 10 pts – Ultranightmare

 25 pts – Pipe Madness

You’ll now earn closer to what you would’ve scored by threading the pipes instead of blowing them away.



🌆 Visual Improvements

Fixed spacing on house windows. Minor tweaks to skyline clarity and UI layering.



🧹 Other Improvements

Continued clarity passes on the codebase.

Minor bugfixes that didn’t deserve a spotlight, but still matter.
